title: Lower Lipschitz bound for a C¹ map near a point where its derivative is injective
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let G : ℝ^n → ℝ^P be a C¹ map and let x ∈ ℝ^n be a point at which the derivative DG(x) : ℝ^n → ℝ^P is injective. Then there are δ > 0 and μ > 0 such that μ|a − b| ≤ |G(a) − G(b)| for all a, b in the open ball B_δ(x). Here ℝ^k = Euclid k carries the Euclidean norm |·|.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (G : Euclid n → Euclid P) (x : Euclid n), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → Injective (fderiv ℝ G x) → ∃ δ μ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ 0 < μ ∧ ∀ a ∈ ball x δ, ∀ b ∈ ball x δ, μ * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖G a - G b‖
